title: Career roadmap · Sustainability Head
summary: Build from climate and energy research into measurable sustainability strategy, decarbonisation, climate risk, ESG systems, resource efficiency and organisational transformation.

facts.Timeline assumption: The roadmap assumes a 2026-start Ph.D. pathway. The first years build scientific and analytical depth; the later years move toward corporate or public-sector sustainability strategy, decarbonisation programs, climate-risk governance and executive leadership.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Develop expertise in climate science, energy systems, carbon accounting, life-cycle assessment, sustainability metrics and environmental policy.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Own a sustainability domain such as corporate decarbonisation, energy transition, climate risk, circular economy or sustainable infrastructure.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead enterprise-wide sustainability programs, disclosures, transition plans, climate-risk programs and cross-functional transformation.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Integrate climate strategy with energy economics, technology, adaptation, finance, regulation and long-term corporate strategy.

rows.text: Climate science, sustainability principles and research methods
Produce a literature-based climate/sustainability systems map with documented assumptions

Create a climate-risk register identifying hazards, exposure, vulnerability and adaptation options

Ministry of Corporate Affairs; NITI Aayog

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Keep scientific depth while developing fluency in corporate finance, energy markets, climate policy, digital measurement, supply-chain sustainability and transition economics. A Sustainability Head must be able to convert environmental targets into capital allocation, operational changes and measurable business outcomes.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Sustainability/Climate Analyst → Sustainability Consultant → Senior Consultant → Sustainability Program Manager → Sustainability Director → Head of Sustainability → Chief Sustainability Officer

items: 15+ years, with substantial variation by sector and employer
blocks.label: Typical planning ranges are

blocks.text: Ph.D. routes

A Sustainability Head should operate at the intersection of science, operations, finance and strategy. Maintain technical credibility in climate and energy while developing the ability to influence capital allocation, supply chains, operations, risk management and corporate strategy. AI-enabled environmental measurement, climate adaptation, energy-system transformation and credible transition planning will remain important areas for continued development.
